finding.body: Impact: `sm-list.bb` parses the ledger by splitting on `(?m)^- ts:`; this entry matches no boundary, so it is silently absorbed into the preceding 2026-10-06 entry's chunk and is never listed as its own reflection. Any future `- ts:`-keyed consumption (the skill's own `sm-log.bb` template, spore-review tooling, human tailing by entry) has the same blind spot. Evidence: the mounted session-mycology skill defines the entry template starting with `- ts:` plus `p-efficiency:`/`p-friction:`/`p-skill-candidate:` fields; all ~40 existing entries in this file begin with `- ts:`; the new entry (lines 525-527) is the only one that does not, and it renames the score keys to prose (`efficiency 0.70; friction 0.62; skill-candidate 0.45`), omitting the field lines (`session`, `task`, `spore`, `receipt-refs`) the template calls for. Smallest corrective direction: rewrite the appended entry in the standard `- ts:` field format (the same content fits), keeping the append-only position.
